"""RoboPaint Dao trajectory generator and observation utilities.

Run one numbered stroke at a time: PYTHONPATH=/opt/tools python gen.py stroke N
The service persists the episode. This script does not reset it.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse, json, math
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from scipy.ndimage import map_coordinates
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT=Path('/app/output')
SHEET=0.227185
MM_PER_PX=SHEET/1024
PAPER_Z=0.0202
SAFE_Z=0.09
INK=(-0.1,0.15,0.023)
Q=(0.,1.,0.,0.)

def pose(x,y,z): return [float(x),float(y),float(z),*Q]
def pixel_xy(u,v): return (-0.1+(512-v)*MM_PER_PX, (512-u)*MM_PER_PX)
def pixpose(u,v,z):
    x,y=pixel_xy(u,v);return pose(x,y,z)

def interpolate_path(points, spacing_mm=0.75):
    """points: (u,v,z). Interpolate at nearly uniform travel speed."""
    out=[]
    for p0,p1 in zip(points,points[1:]):
        a=np.array(p0,float);b=np.array(p1,float)
        d=np.linalg.norm((b[:2]-a[:2])*MM_PER_PX*1000)
        n=max(1,math.ceil(d/spacing_mm))
        for i in range(n):
            p=a+(b-a)*(i/n);out.append(pixpose(*p))
    out.append(pixpose(*points[-1]));return out

# Points are (column u, row v, brush tip z in metres).
# Draw order can be reversed from printed calligraphy to match the brush's natural taper.
STROKES={
 1: [('upper left dot',[(379,327,.015),(372,320,.010),(361,307,.010),(350,296,.011),(337,283,.014),(319,270,.018)])],
 2: [('upper middle dot',[(541,291,.015),(532,284,.011),(521,274,.011),(507,259,.015),(494,248,.018)])],
 3: [('upper right sweep',[(656,218,.014),(675,225,.009),(682,235,.008),(661,250,.010),(640,270,.013),(613,294,.017),(594,310,.019)])],
 4: [('long horizontal',[(731,332,.012),(706,329,.010),(662,335,.012),(610,343,.013),(553,352,.014),(501,360,.014),(450,370,.016),(435,367,.018)])],
 5: [('central angled stroke',[(553,359,.016),(558,375,.012),(577,389,.012),(561,407,.012),(541,430,.013)])],
 6: [('enclosure left',[(486,432,.016),(494,454,.012),(500,487,.012),(501,530,.013),(499,572,.013),(494,612,.011),(496,640,.012),(501,650,.018)])],
 7: [('enclosure upper and right',[(504,447,.013),(551,438,.012),(593,426,.011),(637,414,.011),(665,425,.011),(680,438,.011),(670,456,.009),(671,500,.009),(673,548,.009),(676,600,.008),(676,646,.007),(670,673,.014)])],
 8: [('upper inner horizontal',[(513,508,.017),(546,501,.016),(582,492,.015),(608,491,.014)])],
 9: [('lower inner horizontal',[(512,565,.015),(550,557,.014),(584,548,.013),(610,549,.014)])],
 10:[('bottom enclosure stroke',[(509,634,.014),(550,629,.013),(592,620,.011),(625,620,.011),(642,637,.010),(664,671,.013)])],
 11:[('left curved radical',[(252,463,.019),(282,458,.015),(318,444,.011),(350,429,.011),(378,439,.010),(396,450,.011),(377,475,.012),(360,503,.012),(349,532,.012),(351,550,.013),(366,582,.011),(378,612,.010),(375,635,.011),(359,657,.018)])],
 12:[('bottom sweep',[(247,682,.013),(266,693,.011),(300,679,.013),(344,663,.014),(384,662,.014),(431,678,.014),(490,702,.013),(550,723,.011),(616,743,.009),(671,751,.008),(702,752,.008),(740,742,.011),(771,730,.016),(786,727,.019)])],
}

def run_stroke(r,n):
    name,points=STROKES[n][0]
    first=pixpose(*points[0]);last=pixpose(*points[-1]);x0,y0=first[:2];x1,y1=last[:2]
    rows=[]
    # Dip and gather hairs. Keep the brush well above both sheets while travelling.
    rows += [pose(-.1,.15,SAFE_Z)]*8
    rows += [pose(*INK)]*8
    rows += [pose(-.1,.15,SAFE_Z)]*8
    rows += [pose(x0,y0,SAFE_Z)]*10
    rows += [first]*6
    rows += interpolate_path(points)
    rows += [last]*2
    rows += [pose(x1,y1,SAFE_Z)]*12
    if len(rows)>400: raise ValueError(f'{n} has {len(rows)} rows')
    # Entire motion at most 10 s per submit; long strokes are chunked while contact persists.
    start_calls=r.status()['calls']
    for j in range(0,len(rows),180):
        a=r.submit('ee_pose',rows[j:j+180],dt=.05,video='none',cameras=['canvas_cam','scene_cam'],note=f'Dao stroke {n}: {name}, part {j//180+1}')
        if a.stopped or sum(p['ik_failures'] for p in a.meta['plan']):
            raise RuntimeError(f'Stroke {n} execution issue: {a.stopped}, {a.meta["plan"]}')
    a=r.submit('ee_pose',[pose(-.1,.15,SAFE_Z)]*10,dt=.05,video='none',cameras=['canvas_cam'],note=f'Clear canvas after Dao stroke {n}')
    a.save(str(OUT/f'stroke{n:02d}'))
    print('stroke',n,name,'rows',len(rows),'calls',r.status()['calls']-start_calls,'tip',a.meta['proprio']['now'][7:10],'status',r.status(),flush=True)

def camera_to_target(image):
    # Main paper surface at z=20.2 mm. Camera is 599.8 mm above it.
    c=np.asarray(image,dtype=float)
    uv=np.arange(1024,dtype=float)
    world=(512-uv)*MM_PER_PX
    # camera u=512 - y*f/d; v=512 -(x+0.1)*f/d.
    scale=2344.588379/(.62-PAPER_Z)
    camcoord=512-world*scale
    yy,xx=np.meshgrid(camcoord,camcoord,indexing='ij')
    return np.stack([map_coordinates(c[:,:,i],[yy,xx],order=1,mode='nearest') for i in range(3)],axis=-1)

def inspect(n):
    im=np.array(Image.open(OUT/f'stroke{n:02d}'/'last'/'canvas_cam.jpg').convert('RGB'))
    im=camera_to_target(im)
    Image.fromarray(np.uint8(np.clip(im,0,255))).save(OUT/f'canvas{n:02d}.png')
    target=np.array(Image.open('/app/target.png').convert('L'))<100
    ink=im.mean(axis=2)<110
    # Occlusion can be detected by ink-shaped regions outside the paper.
    print('target area',target.sum(),'ink area',ink.sum(),'intersection',np.logical_and(target,ink).sum(),
          'iou',np.logical_and(target,ink).sum()/np.logical_or(target,ink).sum())
    overlay=np.zeros((1024,1024,3),np.uint8)+245
    overlay[np.logical_and(target,ink)]=[20,20,20]
    overlay[np.logical_and(target,~ink)]=[255,90,60]
    overlay[np.logical_and(~target,ink)]=[40,130,255]
    Image.fromarray(overlay).save(OUT/f'overlay{n:02d}.png')

if __name__=='__main__':
 p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('command',choices=['stroke','inspect']);p.add_argument('number',type=int);a=p.parse_args()
 if a.command=='stroke':run_stroke(Robot(),a.number)
 else:inspect(a.number)
